text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our summer training camp with Daring Tact 
concluded 
on an extremely productive note. 
Without a doubt—she has grown stronger.
choice_data_list:
Your current running form has fully 
settled in, hasn't it?

Your current running form has fully 
settled in, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've also figured out how to draw out 
my maximum output with this form.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With this... I can win. 
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup, without 
fail...!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's make sure we win!
Yeah. Let's make sure we win!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, let's take a selfie before we 
head back to the academy! ☆ 
Come on, over here—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Eep?! That scared the crap out of me... 
Wait, isn't that Win Marilyn?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like... she's been going all out 
lately. 
Feels like she's completely changed...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
It's like that ferocity she shows during 
races 
is bleeding into her everyday training...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—Damn right, this is who I am now! 
Sorry if I don't have time to play nice!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A & B
text_block_list.text:
!? 
W-W-We're so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Did I scare you guys?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
I really didn't mean to. 
Oh dear, I just can't seem to break 
character...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's been so long since I felt like 
this! 
This blazing fire inside me—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...I refuse to lose. 
If she's coming at this at her absolute 
best, then—"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I have to play the greatest Win Marilyn I 
can possibly be. 
—At the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You're entering the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup too, Win 
Marilyn...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...For so long, 
I always thought she lived in an entirely 
different world from me."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"An actress of the silver screen, so to 
speak. 
So cosmopolitan, so refined... It's truly 
wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Even when we watched the Shuka Sho 
together... 
seeing how dignified she stood before 
the overwhelming aura of our seniors—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I thought she was so cool, 
and that... 'she was just different from 
me.'"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Far away from the spotlight, 
she was fighting her own battles with 
everything she had, wasn't she?"
choice_data_list:
Maybe you two are more alike in that way 
than you think.

Maybe you two are more alike in that way 
than you think.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, Daring Tact seemed to 
bask 
in constant brilliance... 
Yet the path she had walked was filled 
with storm and turmoil.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...If we truly share that common ground, 
is there something I might be able 
to offer Win Marilyn, I wonder?"
choice_data_list:
...I think you're already giving it to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: —Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, I... gave this summer training 
camp 
every single ounce of effort I had!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I grew stronger using the way that suits 
me best right now. 
I'm sure the underclassmen will show up 
too, but—"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Let's show them all just how strong our 
generation is! 
At the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Win Marilyn...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, our passionate summer 
training camp came to a close—
